# sing-box binaries

This directory contains the official sing-box 1.13.15 amd64 release binaries used by the desktop packages.

Source release:

- https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box/releases/tag/v1.13.15

Contents:

- `win-x64/sing-box.exe` and `win-x64/libcronet.dll`
- `linux-x64/sing-box` and `linux-x64/libcronet.so`
- `LICENSE`, `VERSION`, and `SHA256SUMS`

When updating sing-box, replace both platform directories and update `VERSION` and `SHA256SUMS` together.
